purpose: Single-byte terminate latch for the main 12-slot summon-spell animation; once set it suppresses per-color rotation during the hold-out phase.
logic_summary: Cleared to 0 on INIT (state_code 0, @0x2682E). Set to 1 on the state-6 hold path (@0x2685A). Read byte-wide as the frame-0xB guard in the TICK path (MOVZX/TEST/JNZ @0x2697D): when nonzero the color-rotation step (advance color_rotation_counter, reassign slot color, restart slot frame counter) is skipped. Sole user fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state.
element_semantics: Boolean latch: 0 = color rotation active, 1 = rotation suppressed (animation winding down after state 6).
